test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 16 Mar 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

He asked the cashier if he could get a new bundle of notes.

options.text: He said to the cashier, "Can I get a new bundle of notes?"
He said to the cashier, "Get me a new bundle of notes."
He said to the cashier, "Can you give me a new bundle of notes?"
He said to the cashier, "Do you have a new bundle of notes?"

solution:
The correct answer is "**He said to the cashier, "Can I get a new bundle of notes?"** "

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are a few things to keep in mind when changing from indirect to direct speech.
 
• The reporting verb **asked **will change to "**said to**" as the sentence will be in first-person narrative.
 
• The given sentence will be in the question form with a question mark at the end.
 
• The third person pronoun "**he**" in reported speech will change to "**I**" in the first-person pronoun.
 
• The modal verb "**could**" in the given reported speech will change to "**can**" in direct speech.
 
• We use **modal verbs** in a reported speech to **express meaning** such as possibility, permission, suggestion, advice, and ability to the main verb.

Hence, the correct answer is** option 1**.
